caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent green glass bottle positioned in the center of a plain, off-white background. The bottle has a wide, rounded base that gradually narrows before flaring out slightly at the neck, which is topped with a thick, rounded rim. The green color of the bottle varies in intensity, with lighter and darker areas indicating reflections and shadows, suggesting the reflective qualities of glass. There are no additional objects or elements present in the drawing; the composition is minimal with the bottle as the only subject.
title: Jar
